title: Use the new publication rule from Fall 2026
summary: From Fall 2026 a submitted paper no longer counts; it must be accepted or published.
applicability: All ECE graduate programs: master's, PhD and integrated. Replaced by notice 57963.

steps: Master's: one accepted or published paper, first author after your advisor.
PhD: one SCI(E) journal paper plus one conference paper, domestic journal paper or patent.
Use the current rule notice 57963 for details.

original.text: 대학원 전체 대상(석사, 박사, 석박통합 과정) 학위수여(논문 관련) 변경 내규를 아래와 같이 안내드립니다. (2026. 2. 26.(목) 학부 학사위원회 결정사항)
1. (변경 전, 2026년 8월까지(2026학년도 1학기 심사대상자까지) 적용) 현재 대학원 전체 대상(석사, 박사, 석박통합 과정) 학위수여(논문 관련) 규정 발췌
* 학사안내서 내 논문 관련 규정을 발췌한 부분이며,
아래 내용 이외의 다른 학위수여 규정은 모두 변경 없이 이전과 동일하게 충족하셔야 하오니 반드시 학사안내서 내용 확인하여 주시기 바랍니다.

rows:
가. 석사: 본인의 이름이 지도교수를 제외한 논문저자 중 첫 번째로 되어 있는 학술대회 논문을 1편 이상 발표하였거나 논문지 논문을 1편 이상 게재하여야 함. 단, 지도교수가 해당 논문의 공동저자로 포함되어야 함.
- 다만, 논문심사 안내 게시글(https://ece.snu.ac.kr/community/academics?md=v&bbsidx=56884) 내용 참고하여 논문지 논문 1편 이상 게재 혹은 투고하였음을 증명할 수 있는 관련 서류 제출 시 인정 가능
- 석사는 본인의 이름이 첫 번째로 되어 있어도 공동1저자라면 인정 불가

나. 박사 및 석박통합: 아래의 ①항과 ②항, 두 가지 조건 모두 만족해야 하며 지도교수의 이름이 공동저자로 포함되고, 본인의 이름이 지도교수를 제외한 저자 중 첫 번째로 되어 있는 논문
혹은 특허만 인정됨.
(①항) 국제적으로 인정되는 논문지(SCI(E)급)에 1편 이상의 논문을 게재하여야 함.
(②항) 국제학술대회 발표논문 1편, 또는 국내논문지 게재논문 1편, 또는 등록된 국제특허 1편 이상이 있어야 함.
- 다만, 논문심사 안내 게시글(https://ece.snu.ac.kr/community/academics?md=v&bbsidx=56884) 내용 참고하여 1항의 경우 게재 또는 게재확정을 증명할 수 있는 서류 제출 시 인정 가능

original.text: 2. (변경 후, 2026년 9월부터(2026학년도 2학기 심사대상자부터) 적용) 대학원 전체 대상(석사, 박사, 석박통합 과정) 학위수여(논문 관련) 규정 변경 내용 안내

* 아래 내용은 2026년 9월부터 적용되는 변경(신규) 규정인지라, 보완(수정)이 필요한 내용이 있다면 행정실에서도 검토 후 해당 게시글을 통해 수정 안내드릴 수 있어 변동이 있을 수 있다는 점 참고하여 주시기 바랍니다. 정확한 규정 또는 최종적인 충족(인정) 여부는 소속 학과의 판단(기준)에 따르기 때문에, 모호하거나 판단하기 어려우신 부분들은 행정실 담당자에게 반드시 문의하여 주시기 바랍니다.

english: This notice explains the changed internal rules on degree conferral (publication requirements) for all graduate students (Master's, PhD, and integrated Master's-PhD programs), as set out below. (Decided by the department's Academic Affairs Committee on 26 Feb 2026 (Thu))

1. (Before the change; applies until August 2026, i.e. up to students whose thesis is examined in the 1st semester of the 2026 academic year) Excerpt of the current degree conferral (publication-related) rules for all graduate students (Master's, PhD, and integrated Master's-PhD programs)
* This is an excerpt of the publication-related rules in the 학사안내서 (Academic Guidebook).
All other degree conferral rules not covered below stay the same with no changes, and you must still meet them as before, so please make sure to check the 학사안내서 (Academic Guidebook).

A. Master's: You must have presented at least 1 conference paper or published at least 1 journal paper in which your name is listed first among the authors, not counting your advisor. However, your advisor must be included as a co-author of that paper.
- However, with reference to the thesis examination notice (https://ece.snu.ac.kr/community/academics?md=v&bbsidx=56884), this can be accepted if you submit documents proving that you have published or submitted at least 1 journal paper.
- For Master's students, a co-first authorship is not accepted, even if your name is listed first.

B. PhD and integrated Master's-PhD: You must meet both conditions ① and ② below. Only papers or patents that include your advisor as a co-author and list your name first among the authors, not counting your advisor, are accepted.
(Condition ①) You must have published at least 1 paper in an internationally recognized journal (SCI(E) level).
(Condition ②) You must have at least 1 paper presented at an international conference, or 1 paper published in a domestic (Korean) journal, or 1 registered international patent.
- However, with reference to the thesis examination notice (https://ece.snu.ac.kr/community/academics?md=v&bbsidx=56884), Condition 1 can be accepted if you submit documents proving publication or confirmed acceptance for publication.

2. (After the change; applies from September 2026, i.e. from students whose thesis is examined in the 2nd semester of the 2026 academic year) Changes to the degree conferral (publication-related) rules for all graduate students (Master's, PhD, and integrated Master's-PhD programs)

* The content below is a changed (new) rule that applies from September 2026. If anything needs to be supplemented (corrected), the department office may review it and announce corrections through this post, so please note that the content may change. The exact rules and the final decision on whether a requirement is met (accepted) follow the judgment (criteria) of your department, so please be sure to contact the staff in charge at the department office about anything that is unclear or difficult to judge.

A. Master's: At least 1 domestic or international conference paper or 1 journal paper, in which your name is listed first among the authors, not counting your advisor, must be published (or confirmed for publication). (However, your advisor must be included as a co-author of that paper.)
- The document proving the above publication or confirmed acceptance must be one that can be issued before the result document submission date stated in the thesis examination notice for your examination semester. (In other words, the achievement is accepted only if proof such as a publication record or an acceptance email can be issued before the result document submission date.)
- From students examined in the 2nd semester of the 2026 academic year, documents proving only that you have submitted a paper to a journal will NOT be accepted, even if submitted!!
- For Master's students, a co-first authorship is not accepted, even if your name is listed first.

B. PhD and integrated Master's-PhD: You must meet both conditions 1 and 2 below. Only papers or patents that include your advisor as a co-author and list your name first among the authors, not counting your advisor, are accepted.
(Condition 1) At least 1 paper published or confirmed for publication in an internationally recognized journal (SCI(E) level). (However, your advisor must be included as a co-author of that paper.)
(Condition 2) 'At least 1 international conference paper or 1 domestic (Korean) journal paper' published or confirmed for publication, or at least 1 registered international patent. (However, your advisor must be included as a co-author of that paper.)
- For both Conditions 1 and 2 above, the document proving publication or confirmed acceptance must be one that can be issued before the thesis examination result document submission date stated in the thesis examination notice for your examination semester. (In other words, the achievement is accepted only if proof such as a publication record or an acceptance email can be issued before the result document submission date.)

- Please be sure to contact the staff in charge at the department office about anything that is unclear or difficult to judge.
- Please note that the exact rules and the final decision on whether a requirement is met (accepted) follow the judgment (criteria) of your department. Sometimes, even when the above content seems to be met, the requirement is not accepted because of detailed rules or a student's individual situation. In such cases, some students raise objections based on the information given above, so this is announced in advance to prevent such situations. Thank you for your understanding :)

- Must-read information for graduate students: https://ece.snu.ac.kr/community/academics?md=v&bbsidx=56747
- List of conferences accepted as international journal (SCI(E)) level for the PhD degree requirements: https://ece.snu.ac.kr/community/academics?md=v&bbsidx=52081
- Information on co-first authorship: https://ece.snu.ac.kr/community/academics?md=v&bbsidx=55998
* Inquiries: Please send an email to the staff in charge at the department office (이소연 (Lee So-yeon), soyeon12@snu.ac.kr). Emails are answered in the order they are received.
